heading: Cluster verification
cmds: kubectl config current-context; kubectl config get-contexts

heading: Kubernetes Basics tutorial
cmds: kubectl -n s9 get deployments; kubectl -n s9 get pods -o wide
POD=$(kubectl -n s9 get pods -o jsonpath="{.items[0].metadata.name}"); kubectl -n s9 exec $POD -- wget -qO- lo

heading: Kubernetes Basics tutorial
cmds: kubectl -n s9 scale deployment/web-basics --replicas=4; kubectl -n s9 rollout status deployment/web-basics --t
kubectl -n s9 set image deployment/web-basics nginx=nginx:1.25-alpine; kubectl -n s9 rollout status deployment

heading: Kubernetes Basics tutorial
cmds: kubectl -n s9 get pods; kubectl -n s9 describe deployment web-basics | grep -i "image:"
kubectl -n s9 rollout undo deployment/web-basics; kubectl -n s9 rollout status deployment/web-basics --timeout
kubectl -n s9 describe deployment web-basics | grep -i "image:"
